COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.

2. Which statement about Implementation and Reflection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation and Reflection.
   B. Treat Implementation and Reflection as rumours only.
   C. Say Implementation and Reflection never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Implementation and Reflection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Support Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Support Systems.
   C. Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Support Systems as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action .
   C. Explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  never happens in Kenya.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

6. Which statement about Problem Validation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Validation.
   B. Say Problem Validation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Problem Validation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Problem Validation as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen.
   C. Say Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup.
   B. Say Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup as rumours only.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

10. Which statement about Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship.
   B. Explain Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Making Important Choices and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Validation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
